description: Pulse Wave 6.1.21 — Drag & Drop Custom Library Ordering, Strict Playlist & Shuffle Isolation, Dot-Matrix & Vinyl Controls with Rewind/Forward, UPI Fix for P2P Payments, Download Warning Resolution, and Player Deck Controls.

changelog.title: Library & Playlist Drag-and-Drop Reordering
items: Full Drag-and-Drop Organization: Enabled drag-and-drop reordering with persistent custom sorting in both Library and Playlists screens for both Grid and List layouts.
Custom Playlists to the Top: Local and user playlists (such as my MP4 or Mp3 FAV) can now be freely positioned above auto playlists or at the very top of the Library.
Synced Custom Covers: Fixed playlist card covers so custom images set on auto playlists reflect consistently across screens.
Local Playlist Switch: Added a dedicated toggle for the Local music playlist in Appearance Settings under Auto Playlists.

changelog.title: Strict Playlist Playback & Shuffle Isolation
items: Fixed Queue Boundary: Shuffling or playing a playlist now strictly plays songs contained inside that playlist, preventing external radio or automix tracks from being mixed in.
Direct Shuffle & Repeat Controls: Added dedicated Shuffle and Repeat buttons directly to the player controls row with glowing active states so state is instantly visible.

changelog.title: Vinyl & Nothing OS Widget Enhancements
items: Vinyl Widget Controls: Restored rewind (-10s) and fast-forward (+10s) controls on the Vinyl turntable widget dock, properly registered with system broadcast intent filters.
Nothing OS Widget Sync: Connected the Nothing OS dot-matrix player widget to the active music service dispatch loop for live progress updates.

changelog.title: UPI Payments & In-App Support
items: NPCI P2P Intent Standards: Cleaned UPI payment URI schema by removing merchant-only transaction ref tags that caused FamPay and other UPI apps to force-quit.
Payee & Custom Amount: Configured BS.Framework5253 as the project payee with direct support for custom contribution amounts.

changelog.title: Bug Fixes & System Stability
items: Local Track Download Warning Fix: Excluded local device files from download error checks, eliminating false warning badges on local MP3 playlists.
YouTube Playlist Sync: Fixed double-VL prefixing on InnerTube playlist requests so remote YouTube Music playlists sync reliably.
Auto-Updater Reliability: Modernized APK archive parsing for Android 13+ to avoid false-negative corruptions.
